name: FSL Reorient and Crop T2
summary: Reorients a T2-weighted image to the standard (MNI152) orientation with FSL fslreorient2std and crops the lower head and neck with robustfov.
description: Runs fslreorient2std and then robustfov on the input T2-weighted image; either step can be switched off. Use it early in anatomical preprocessing so later steps see a standard-oriented, tightly cropped head. It only reorients and crops; it does not register the image to a template.

outputs.description: The reoriented and/or cropped T2-weighted image.

parameters.description: Run fslreorient2std to reorient the T2 to the standard (MNI152) orientation.
Run robustfov to crop the field of view and remove the lower head and neck.
